location_note: Western Wall Tunnels, c. 10 m west of Warren's Gate; no map reference. Placed by the title name Jerusalem (Z4).
notes: Pottery report for the Warren's Gate excavation (Onn and Weksler-Bdolah, 'Atiqot 106, not in this reader's units). Channels 1919a and 1919b are coded as the pottery's context (choice C2): fill below them Late Roman (2nd-4th c.), fill inside them 3rd-5th c. CE.

features.period: Stratum IV, Late Roman-Byzantine; fill inside the channels 3rd-5th c. CE
features.quote: The pottery was retrieved from the fill (L1919) inside Channels 1919a
